mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, reducing conversion of tamoxifen to its active metabolite endoxifen, thereby decreasing tamoxifen's therapeutic efficacy in breast cancer treatment.
action: Consider alternative antibiotic with minimal CYP450 interactions (e.g., amoxicillin, doxycycline); if clarithromycin is necessary, monitor for reduced tamoxifen efficacy and counsel patient accordingly.
